collection.title: Renault Avantime 2001 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Renault Avantime 2001 to 2003 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment, this vehicle also has the spray bar attachment. We also have rear blade for this Avantime, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
